summary: Brighton City Airport (ESH), historically known as Shoreham Airport, is a regional airfield situated on the south coast of England in East Sussex, serving the popular seaside city of Brighton and surrounding areas. The airport has a long aviation heritage dating back to the early 20th century and primarily supports general aviation, flight training, private charter, and recreational flying rather than scheduled commercial services. Its coastal location near the South Downs offers distinctive approaches and scenic surroundings unique among UK airfields.
faqs:
Q: Where is Brighton City Airport located?
A: The airport is located in Shoreham-by-Sea, just west of Brighton in East Sussex, on the south coast of England approximately 50 miles south of London.

Q: Does Brighton City Airport offer scheduled commercial flights?
A: The airport primarily caters to general aviation, private charters, flight training, and air charter services rather than scheduled airline operations.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: Facilities include aircraft hangars, flight training schools, refueling services, and private hire operations for passengers and crew.

Q: Can I fly into Brighton City Airport from London?
A: Private charter flights and air taxi services can arrange transfers from London-area airports, with flight times typically under one hour depending on routing and aircraft type.
transport_tips: The airport is roughly a 30-minute drive from central Brighton via the A259 coastal road, and taxi services are readily available from Brighton and Hove. The nearest mainline railway station is Shoreham-by-Sea, which connects to Brighton and London Victoria via direct Southern services. Several local bus routes also serve the Shoreham area, though a private vehicle or pre-booked taxi is the most convenient option for passengers carrying luggage.
local_tip: If visiting the area, time your trip to coincide with sunset over the South Downs—the airport's coastal position offers spectacular views of the English Channel, and the nearby town of Shore
